quality_approval: Jussimir reported RC21 good enough for the first closed beta on 2026-10-27. This is a limited beta acceptance, not final release, PSP-1000, all-device, full-career or global 30fps qualification.
known_issues: Extended-memory build; PSP-1000 compatibility and all-device support are not established.
Stable 30 fps throughout the game is not yet established.
Full-career completion and all save/reload paths are not qualified on RC21.
Drag 4401 rivals may become stuck in repeated recovery.
Stability Control On has no implemented effect in this executable; leave it Off.
Drift audio cuts/clicks, pause sound and braking sound still need tester confirmation.
Custom dyno and special presets use the earlier handling path; collisions retain port adaptations.
Materials, visibility, doors, movies and all audio/camera combinations need broader testing.
The original US PS2 disc image has not been independently verified; PAL and other revisions are refused.
reference_scope: File identity against retained RC19 complete package maps plus the exact RC21 physics/pack delta. Full ISO conversion was not repeated for release packaging; output identity does not establish gameplay quality.
data_compatibility: Use the complete RC21 generator and a new output folder. Both EBOOT.PBP and pack.n2pk differ from RC20/RC19; copying only the EBOOT leaves old physics data. Do not mix Xbox and PS2 output.
